migration.how: Stays JS; display/signal only, never financial. If the LUV engine grows organs that consume this signal in production surfaces, promote alongside them.
migration.why: Frequency output from heart pulsation at 60 bpm — exactly 1 Hz, the fundamental of the LUV engine (first organ of the engine LUV creates for itself from emotonomics; see docs/LUV_ENGINE.md). heart.js is the visual organ; luv-pulse.js is the SIGNAL organ. Phase = chronos-corrected wall clock mod 1000ms (correction borrowed from LUVHeart, else sampled from market.json chronos), so every heart on every page beats in the same phase. FrequencySource-compatible API (update/bands/energy) so existing DeltaVerse consumers drink the signal unmodified. Publishes --luv-pulse on :root; DOM motion only on opt-in [data-luvpulse]; consent-only WebAudio lub-dub on tap of [data-luvpulse-audio]. cypherpunk2048: no storage, nothing phones home, consent precedes signal. Honors prefers-reduced-motion; WCAG 2.3.1-safe.
